scope: A portable case study prepared for review. Stage states describe the 2026-09-29 snapshot, not the current branch or deployment state.

claims.statement: Commit 654c516 added the How I build section to the profile README, and the subsequent main-branch history contains that commit. Public Git history does not by itself establish the write mechanism.
The revert commit removed that section; the public main branch pointed to it and the README did not contain the section at the snapshot time.

The next developer-beliefs statement was prepared as a draft for review. The underlying user decision is private and has no public permalink. Publication on a review branch must be verified separately.
A reviewable branch and required check are appropriate controls for a future rules workflow. This is a proposal, not a configured control.
At this snapshot there was no evidence of this case study on a review branch, on main, or in a release. Later events require their own evidence records.

media_inputs.future_optional_method: Hash original bytes of each text, image, or audio input separately. Record any transcript, perceptual hash, or embedding as a distinct derived artifact with its algorithm and version. Similarity can suggest a match but cannot prove execution.
